title: Create tenant onboarding flow — signup to tenant creation to redirect
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding wizard: step 1 — create account (email/password or Google), step 2 — set tenant name and subdomain, step 3 — configure plan (free/tiered)
Signup API auto-creates tenant record with unique slug/subdomain
User record linked to new tenant via tenant_id foreign key
Onboarding completion redirects user to tenant dashboard
Tenant slug uniqueness enforced at DB level with unique constraint
Welcome email sent (or queued for future) on tenant creation
